CO2016B-P1-21.exp: A microcomputer's system bus pairs the address bus, which says where, with the data bus, which carries the actual bits to and from that location. Option C just repeats the address bus already named in the question, and control lines are the third, separate group.

CO2016B-P1-22.exp: Addressing capacity depends only on the width of the address bus, so 32 address lines give 2^32 = 4 GB of addressable memory. The 16-bit data bus is a red herring; 64 K would be the answer for a 16-bit address bus.

CO2016B-P1-23.exp: Requirement determination establishes WHAT information the organisation needs, before any decision on technology. Working out HOW to supply it is the later design phase, which is the classic distractor here.

CO2016B-P1-24.exp: Systems are modified because user requirements have changed or grown; that business need is the objective. Adopting newer tools or hardware is only a means, never a goal in itself.

CO2016B-P1-25.exp: System software (the operating system, device drivers and translators) drives the hardware and provides the platform on which application software runs. Utility software is only a sub-category of system software, so it is too narrow.

CO2016B-P1-26.exp: Data are raw, meaningless facts and figures; information is what results after data are processed and meaning is attached. Option A is the only one carrying that two-part definition, although it is printed as a badly run-together sentence with the punctuation lost.

CO2016B-P1-27.exp: C is a compiled language, so a compiler translates the whole source file into machine code in one pass. Language translator is the umbrella term covering compilers, interpreters and assemblers alike, so it is correct but not specific enough to be the answer.

CO2016B-P1-28.exp: The first printf shows 4; i-- is post-decrement so it prints 4 and only then leaves i as 3; --i is pre-decrement so it drops i to 2 first and prints 2. Hence 4, 4, 2 - the trap is reading i-- as printing 3.

CO2016B-P1-29.exp: The JVM is the one platform-specific piece: a separate JVM build exists for Windows, Linux, macOS and so on. Source files and the compiled bytecode .class files are identical everywhere, which is precisely what write-once-run-anywhere means.

CO2016B-P1-30.exp: The pillars of OOP are encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism and abstraction. Parallelism is a concurrency concept unrelated to the object model.

CO2016B-P1-31.exp: In a client-server setup the clients are normally ordinary desktop PCs, i.e. microcomputers. Mainframes and minicomputers act as servers, and a PDA is only an occasional special-case client.

CO2016B-P1-32.exp: Intellectual property rights is a broad umbrella covering copyright, patents, trademarks, trade dress, trade secrets and know-how. Since all three listed items fall inside it, the inclusive option is correct.

CO2016B-P1-33.exp: In the standard textbook framing an operating system exists to manage and make the most efficient use of the hardware resources, with user convenience following from that. Note the genuine ambiguity: Silberschatz actually ranks convenience first for single-user machines and efficiency first for shared ones, so option D is arguable, but A is the answer these question banks intend.

CO2016B-P1-34.exp: TREE displays the directory and subdirectory hierarchy of a drive or path graphically. LIST, SUBDIR and SUBTREE are not DOS commands at all.

CO2016B-P1-35.exp: TYPE filename dumps the contents of a text file to the screen. COPY duplicates a file rather than displaying it, and EDIT (not Ed) opens an editor instead of simply showing the contents.

CO2016B-P1-36.exp: DIR /B gives bare format: names only, with no heading, size, date, time or byte summary. DIR /W is wide format, which still suppresses details but arranges names in columns; /B is the switch defined by stripping everything except names.

CO2016B-P1-37.exp: To list a directory nested one level below a subdirectory you must spell out both path levels, so DIR \pathname\pathname is the right form. Option D ends in a filename and so lists a single file, not all files, and /CH is not a valid DIR switch.

CO2016B-P1-38.exp: MD and MKDIR are two names for the same DOS command that creates a directory, so both options are correct. DIR only lists a directory's contents.

CO2016B-P1-39.exp: RD (RMDIR) removes a directory, and DOS permits it only when the directory is already empty. DEL and ERASE delete files rather than directories, and MD does the opposite by creating one.

CO2016B-P1-40.exp: The loader brings the executable image into main memory, assigns addresses and hands control to it. The linker runs earlier, combining object modules into one executable file on disk.
